sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Vacant seats in the National Assembly
maudhui: The National Assembly may transact its business at its sittings notwithstanding that there is a vacancy among the seats of Members, whether the vacancy has existed since Parliament first met after a General Election or arose after that first meeting; and where any person who is not entitled to participate takes part in such business, or any person not entitled to be present is present during such business, that participation or presence shall not invalidate the proceedings.
